verdict.rationale: Framer documents several official developer surfaces — a Plugins API, Code Components (React), a Fetch API, and a Server API for publishing/automation — plus a dedicated External Agent connection for Claude Code/Cursor/Codex to read/write CMS and canvas content, which is a strong agentic-build story. However, probes show no discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec and 404s on structured API docs, and there is no independent/hands-on corroboration of building against these SDKs. Missing for 10: a public OpenAPI/formal API reference, independent developer reports validating SDK stability, and multi-language SDK support beyond JS/React.
